Takes about a share of the items, each the same way every time: at 30, about 3 in 10 go on, and the rest leave from rest.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.sample` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main`, `rest` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Chance % (`chance`) | number | yes |  | The share to take, 0 to 100: 30 is about 3 in 10. |
| Decide by (`field`) | text | no | `txHash` | The field that tells items apart, e.g. txHash for trades or id: an item with the same value gets the same answer, on a re-run too. Names a field of the items it receives; saving checks the items have it. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
